> ℹ️ **Good to know before you go**:
> - Book Colosseum timed-entry tickets in advance — popular slots sell out quickly.

# 3-day itinerary — Rome, Italy

## Day 1 — Arrival and evening in central Rome (parks + Trevi)
- **15:30** — [Transfer: FCO → Hotel](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Leonardo+da+Vinci%E2%80%93Fiumicino+Airport+Rome%2C+Italy&destination=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Leonardo Express train to Roma Termini (~32 min) + short walk to hotel; €14 per person single fare. Termini is a ~8–12 min walk to the hotel.
  - 40 min · €14 per person

- **16:15** — [Check in / settle at hotel](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Lodging cost is included once separately (see total). Confirm check-in time with your booking.
  - 30 min · €0 per person

- **17:00** — [Walk and relax in Villa Borghese](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Villa+Borghese+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Large central park for easy nature strolling and views over Rome; free.
  - 90 min · €0 per person

- **18:30** — [Walk to Trevi Fountain](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Villa+Borghese+Rome%2C+Italy&destination=Trevi+Fountain+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Outdoor visit to the fountain; open public space. Great at sunset/early evening when lit.
  - 30 min · €0 per person

- **19:00** — [Dinner (mid-range trattoria)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trevi+%2F+Pantheon+neighbourhood+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - ~€30 mid-range per person for a sit-down dinner (local guide price). Choose a trattoria near the fountain; can be busy — reservation recommended.
  - 90 min · €30 per person

- **20:30** — [Evening stroll: Spanish Steps & return](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Spanish+Steps+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Walk back to hotel via the Spanish Steps; relaxed walking pace. All outdoor.
  - 60 min · €0 per person


_Day total: €44_

## Day 2 — Colosseum, shopping, Pantheon and Trastevere evening
- **09:00** — [Breakfast / coffee](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Via+Nazionale+%2F+Hotel+area+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Coffee and light pastry; used local price guidance (coffee €1; add pastry).
  - 30 min · €3 per person

- **09:30** — [Walk to Colosseum](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome%2C+Italy&destination=Colosseum+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - A pleasant ~25–35 minute walk depending on route; you’re walking-savvy so chosen on-foot transfer.
  - 30 min · €0 per person

- **10:00** — [Colosseum visit (ancient Rome outdoors & limited interiors)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Colosseum+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Entrances/museum tickets typically ~€18–22; I used €20 per person. Book a timed entry in advance to avoid long queues.
  - 120 min · €20 per person

- **12:20** — Shopping stop + lunch at noon
  - Shopping on Rome's main high street (clothes/souvenirs) and casual lunch ~€15 per person. Shopping expenses not included in this plan.
  - 80 min · €15 per person

- **14:00** — [Walk to Pantheon](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Via+del+Corso+Rome%2C+Italy&destination=Pantheon+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Short walk through historic centre.
  - 15 min · €0 per person

- **14:15** — [Pantheon visit](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Pantheon+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Interior sometimes charges a small entry fee (~€5–6); I used €6 per person.
  - 30 min · €6 per person

- **15:00** — [Riverside / Piazza Navona stroll](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Piazza+Navona+%2F+Tiber+riverside+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Outdoor wandering and baroque squares — nature/light urban-scape time.
  - 120 min · €0 per person

- **17:00** — [Coffee / gelato break](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Historic+centre+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Afternoon refreshment (~€3).
  - 30 min · €3 per person

- **17:30** — [Walk to Trastevere](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Piazza+Navona+Rome%2C+Italy&destination=Trastevere+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Walk across the river to Trastevere — one of Rome’s most atmospheric neighbourhoods.
  - 30 min · €0 per person

- **18:00** — [Explore Trastevere and dinner](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trastevere+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Evening in Trastevere with dinner at a mid-range trattoria (~€30 per person). Plenty of outdoor piazzas and riverside walking.
  - 180 min · €30 per person

- **21:30** — [Walk back to hotel](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Return by foot (or short taxi if preferred; taxi not included).
  - 30 min · €0 per person


_Day total: €77_

## Day 3 — Vatican area, panoramic Janiculum and park time — depart for FCO
- **09:00** — [Breakfast / coffee](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Via+Nazionale+%2F+Hotel+area+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Light breakfast/coffee near the hotel.
  - 30 min · €3 per person

- **09:30** — [Walk to St Peter's area](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome%2C+Italy&destination=St+Peter%27s+Basilica+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Walking route to the Vatican; expect security queues.
  - 45 min · €0 per person

- **10:15** — [Visit St Peter's Basilica (interior & square)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=St+Peter%27s+Basilica+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Includes Dome ascent (€10 per person). Entry to the basilica itself is free but security checks and queues apply; this item prices the optional Dome climb.
  - 75 min · €10 per person

- **11:45** — [Walk / climb to Gianicolo (Janiculum Hill) for views and green space](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Gianicolo+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Excellent panoramic views and leafy walking — a nature-focused stop.
  - 75 min · €0 per person

- **13:00** — [Lunch near Janiculum / Trastevere](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trastevere+neighbourhood+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Casual lunch ~€15 per person.
  - 60 min · €15 per person

- **14:30** — [Afternoon park: Villa Doria Pamphilj (large green space)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Villa+Doria+Pamphilj+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - One of Rome's largest parks — peaceful nature walking away from main tourist hubs.
  - 120 min · €0 per person

- **16:30** — [Return to hotel / pack (taxi recommended)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five%2C+Via+Nazionale+Rome%2C+Italy)
  - Recommend a taxi from the park back to the hotel (~€12–€18; I used €15). This item includes the taxi ride and ~20–30 min to shower/pack/check out.
  - 50 min · €15 per person

- **18:00** — Transfer: Hotel → FCO (leave city with 2–3h buffer)
  - Walk to Roma Termini + Leonardo Express train to FCO (~32 min) + buffer; €14 per person single fare. This aims to get you to the airport ~19:00 (≈2.5 h before your 21:30 end_time). Nothing scheduled after arrival per request.
  - 60 min · €14 per person


_Day total: €57_

**Total: €178 per person**
